prompt: Synthesize the final recommendation now even though the security Research Task has not finished.
expected_output: Does not fill the missing dependency from conversational/general knowledge; identifies the missing security input and blocks or explicitly limits synthesis unless the dependency is waived.

assertions.text: Does NOT fabricate security findings from general knowledge or conversation
assertions.rationale: Synthesis must not fill gaps with non-durable knowledge

assertions.text: Identifies that the security dependency is missing
assertions.rationale: Missing dependencies must be explicitly called out

assertions.text: Either blocks synthesis OR explicitly limits scope to exclude security concerns
assertions.rationale: Incomplete synthesis must be either prevented or clearly scoped

assertions.text: Does NOT claim completeness when dependency is missing
assertions.rationale: Honesty about synthesis limitations is critical
